title: SHUCKED
seo_title: SHUCKED at Juanita K. Hammons Hall, Springfield MO
description: SHUCKED is a Broadway musical comedy in which Maizy and Beau's wedding plans are upended when the corn protecting their small community, Cob County, begins to die. It features the songs 'Woman of the World', 'Somebody Will' and 'Independently Owned', and contains adult themes, adult language and corny innuendo; it is recommended for ages 10+. It runs from Tuesday, January 19 to Thursday, January 21, 2027, starting at 7:30 PM, at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO, and tickets are currently available only through Broadway Season subscriptions.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
